prompt: She has been living in ______ European country for two years.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'European' begins with a consonant sound (/jʊərəˈpiːən/).
explanationNp: 'European' को उच्चारण 'यु' (Consonant Sound) बाट हुने भएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He returned home after ______ hour of waiting at the station.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'hour' has a silent 'h' and begins with a vowel sound (/aʊər/).
explanationNp: 'hour' मा 'h' Silent रहने हुनाले स्वर ध्वनि ('आ') बाट सुरु हुन्छ, त्यसैले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: ______ Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before the proper names of individual mountain peaks.
explanationNp: एउटा मात्रै सर्वोच्च शिखर वा हिमालको नाम (Mount Everest) अगाडि कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: She bought ______ umbrella to protect herself from the rain.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'umbrella' begins with a vowel sound (/ʌmˈbrɛlə/).
explanationNp: 'umbrella' स्वर ध्वनि ('अ') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He is ______ honest officer who never takes bribes.
hint: Pay attention to the initial sound of 'honest'.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'honest' starts with a silent 'h' and a vowel sound (/ˈɒnɪst/).
explanationNp: 'honest' मा 'h' Silent भई स्वर ध्वनि ('अ') आउने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ Bagmati is considered a holy river in Nepal.
explanationEn: 'The' is used before proper names of rivers.
explanationNp: नदीको नाम अगाडि सधैँ 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: My brother is studying to become ______ engineer.
hint: Profession starting with a vowel sound.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'engineer' starts with a vowel sound (/ɛndʒɪˈnɪər/).
explanationNp: 'engineer' स्वर ध्वनि ('इ') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'an' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: They visited ______ United Kingdom last summer.
explanationEn: 'the' is used for country names containing words like 'United', 'Kingdom', or 'Republic'.
explanationNp: 'United' वा 'Kingdom' जोडिएका देशको नाम अगाडि 'the' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ water in this pitcher is not clean enough to drink.
explanationEn: 'The' is used because 'water' is specified by the phrase 'in this pitcher'.
explanationNp: यस घडाको तोकिएको पानी (specific water) को कुरा भएकाले 'The' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Milk is good for ______ health.
hint: Abstract noun used in a general sense.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before abstract nouns used in a general sense.
explanationNp: सामान्य अर्थमा 'health' जस्ता Abstract Noun अगाडि कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: He gave me ______ one-rupee coin as a souvenir.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'one' starts with a consonant sound (/wʌn/).
explanationNp: 'one' को उच्चारण 'व' (Consonant Sound) बाट हुने हुनाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: She plays ______ flute every evening in her room.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before musical instruments when referring to playing them.
explanationNp: बाजा बजाउने कुरा गर्दा बाजाको नाम अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: It was ______ unexpected turn of events.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'unexpected' begins with a vowel sound (/ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd/).
explanationNp: 'unexpected' को उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि ('अ') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ rich should always help the needy.
hint: Adjective representing an entire class of people.
explanationEn: 'The' placed before an adjective converts it into a plural noun representing the entire group.
explanationNp: 'The rich' ले संसारका सम्पूर्ण धनी वर्गलाई बुझाउने भएकाले 'The' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: I met ______ university professor at the seminar yesterday.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'university' begins with a consonant sound (/juːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/).
explanationNp: 'university' को उच्चारण 'यु' (Consonant Sound) बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: My father reads ______ Kathmandu Post every morning.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before proper names of newspapers.
explanationNp: पत्रपत्रिकाको नाम अगाडि सधैँ 'the' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He was appointed as ______ S.P. of the district police.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'S.P.' begins with a vowel sound (/ɛs/).
explanationNp: 'S.P.' को उच्चारण गर्दा स्वर ध्वनि ('एस') आउने भएकाले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: She lives in ______ small apartment near the station.
hint: Singular countable noun introduced for the first time.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'small' begins with a consonant sound (/sm/).
explanationNp: 'small' व्यञ्जन ध्वनिबाट सुरु हुने र सामान्य अर्थमा आएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: We had lunch at ______ restaurant near the river.
hint: Unspecified singular countable noun introduced for the first time.
explanationEn: 'a' introduces an unspecified singular noun with a consonant sound.
explanationNp: पहिलो पटक कुरा गरिएको सामान्य रेस्टुरेन्ट भएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: ______ sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
explanationEn: 'The' is used before unique astronomical and natural entities.
explanationNp: संसारमा एउटै मात्र भएको वस्तु (Sun) अगाडि 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He went to ______ hospital to visit his sick friend.
hint: Visiting an institution for a secondary/other purpose.
explanationEn: 'the' is used when visiting an institution (hospital) for a purpose other than receiving treatment.
explanationNp: बिरामी भेट्न (द्वितीयक उद्देश्यले) अस्पताल जाँदा 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Children usually go to ______ school at eight in the morning.
hint: Visiting an institution for its primary purpose.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used when visiting school for its primary function (studying).
explanationNp: अध्ययन गर्न स्कुल जाँदा (प्राथमिक उद्देश्य) कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: She is ______ taller of the two sisters.
hint: Comparative degree used for selection between two.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before a comparative adjective when indicating selection between two entities.
explanationNp: दुईजना बीच तुलना गरेर एकजना छान्दा Comparative degree अगाडि 'the' लाग्छ।

prompt: Copper is ______ useful metal in electrical wiring.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'useful' starts with a consonant sound (/juːsfʊl/).
explanationNp: 'useful' को उच्चारण 'यु' (Consonant Sound) बाट हुने हुनाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He has ______ M.A. degree in English literature.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'M.A.' starts with a vowel sound (/ɛm/).
explanationNp: 'M.A.' को उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि ('एम') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: What ______ beautiful scene this is!
explanationEn: 'a' is used in exclamatory structures following 'What' before singular countable nouns.
explanationNp: 'What' बाट सुरु हुने विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यमा 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: They booked a room in ______ hotel near the beach.
hint: Unspecified singular countable noun with a consonant sound.
explanationEn: 'a' is used before 'hotel' as it begins with a consonant sound (/h/).
explanationNp: 'hotel' व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('ह') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ English is spoken in many countries around the world.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before language names when used alone.
explanationNp: भाषाको नाम (English) अगाडि कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: ______ English language has borrowed words from many sources.
explanationEn: 'The' is used when a language name is directly followed by the word 'language'.
explanationNp: भाषाको नाम पछि 'language' शब्द आएमा अगाडि 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He took his ______ coat and walked out into the cold.
hint: Look at the possessive pronoun 'his' before the blank.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used immediately after possessive pronouns like 'his', 'her', or 'my'.
explanationNp: Possessive pronoun ('his', 'my') पछि तुरुन्तै कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: She bought ______ dozen apples from the local vendor.
explanationEn: 'a dozen' is a standard fixed expression for twelve items.
explanationNp: 'a dozen' एउटा निश्चित वाक्यांश हो।

prompt: I need ______ piece of paper to write down the directions.
explanationEn: 'a piece of' is a standard measure phrase for uncountable nouns like 'paper'.
explanationNp: कागज गन्न मिल्ने बनाउन प्रयोग गरिने वाक्यांशमा 'a piece of' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ Gita is one of the most sacred books in Hinduism.
explanationEn: 'The' is used before names of sacred religious texts.
explanationNp: धार्मिक ग्रन्थको नाम अगाडि सधैँ 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He is preparing for ______ ironman triathlon next year.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'ironman' begins with a vowel sound (/ˈaɪən mæn/).
explanationNp: 'ironman' को उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि ('आ') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: We crossed ______ bridge that was built fifty years ago.
hint: Noun specified by a relative defining clause.
explanationEn: 'the' is used because the relative clause 'that was built fifty years ago' specifies the bridge.
explanationNp: पछाडिको वाक्यले तोकेको खास पुल (specific bridge) भएकाले 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: They live in this ______ house on the corner.
hint: Look at the demonstrative determiner 'this' before the blank.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used directly after demonstrative determiners like 'this', 'that', or 'these'.
explanationNp: Demonstrative ('this', 'that') पछि तुरुन्तै कुनै Article (-) प्रयोग हुँदैन।

prompt: She is ______ heir to a massive family fortune.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'heir' has a silent 'h' and begins with a vowel sound (/ɛər/).
explanationNp: 'heir' (उत्तराधिकारी) मा 'h' Silent भई उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि ('ए') बाट हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: He has been playing ______ chess since he was six years old.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before names of sports, games, or board games.
explanationNp: खेलकुदका नाम (chess, football) अगाडि कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: ______ Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
explanationEn: 'The' is required before proper names of oceans.
explanationNp: महासागरको नाम अगाडि सधैँ 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: We stayed at ______ luxurious hotel during our stay in Pokhara.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'luxurious' starts with a consonant sound (/lʌɡˈʒʊərɪəs/).
explanationNp: 'luxurious' व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('ल') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: He works as ______ auditor for a financial firm.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'auditor' begins with a vowel sound (/ˈɔːdɪtər/).
explanationNp: 'auditor' स्वर ध्वनि ('आ') बाट सुरु हुने हुनाले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: She made ______ mistake while calculating the final total.
hint: Singular countable noun in general context.
explanationEn: 'a' is used before 'mistake' as it starts with a consonant sound (/m/).
explanationNp: 'mistake' व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('म') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ gold is a precious metal used in jewelry.
hint: Material/uncountable noun used in a general sense.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before material nouns used in a general sense.
explanationNp: सामान्य अर्थमा Material Noun (सुन, चाँदी) को कुरा गर्दा कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: ______ gold mined in South Africa is exported globally.
hint: Material noun specified by a defining phrase.
explanationEn: 'The' is used when a material noun ('gold') is made specific by a modifying phrase.
explanationNp: साउथ अफ्रिकामा उत्खनन गरिएको तोकिएको सुन भएकाले 'The' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He left for the airport ______ hour ago.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'hour' starts with a vowel sound (/aʊər/).
explanationNp: 'hour' को उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनिबाट हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: She hopes to get ______ job in a multinational company.
hint: Unspecified singular countable noun with a consonant sound.
explanationEn: 'a' is used before 'job' as it begins with a consonant sound (/dʒ/).
explanationNp: 'job' व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('ज') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: I saw ______ one-eyed man asking for directions on the street.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'one-eyed' begins with a consonant sound (/wʌn/).
explanationNp: 'one-eyed' को उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('व') बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
explanationEn: 'The' is required before proper names of deserts.
explanationNp: मरुभूमिको नाम अगाडि सधैँ 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: They arrived on ______ third of October.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before ordinal numbers (e.g., first, second, third).
explanationNp: क्रमवाचक संख्या (Ordinal Numbers जस्तै: first, second, third) अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He is ______ unique artist with a distinctive personal style.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'unique' begins with a consonant sound (/juːˈniːk/).
explanationNp: 'unique' को उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('यु') बाट हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।
